thread:
incident-bot: PAGE @oncall-sre: KV/prefix cache hit-rate collapse detected for customer BigEnterprise (vpc-dedicated pool be-ded-4). Tenant: bigenterprise-tenant-7. Alert: prefix_cache_hit_rate dropped from 0.58 to 0.02 in 6m. Latency tail rising. Automated rule fired: cache-miss-rate > 80%. Please ACK and investigate.

oncall-sre: acked. I'm on it. paging @Aj Patel for help and @Thomas (Infra) for per-tenant ops rights.

Aj Patel: I'm awake, taking a look. What do we know about request patterns?

maria (SRE): Quick summary from dashboards:
- 6:10 UTC: sudden spike in unique prefix keys served for tenant (~+4000 keys/min).
- 6:12 UTC: prefix_cache_hit_rate for tenant ~0.02. Global cache health nominal.
- 6:15 UTC: error-rate for tenant routes up ~3x, p50 latency +80ms.

Customer Success - Elena: BigEnterprise reported production errors around 06:13. They see slower responses and some 500s from our gateway. They've opened a ticket, asking if we have mitigation.

oncall-sre: thoughts — probable cache pollution from an upstream client generating high-cardinality prefixes. We should isolate tenant caching first (disable prefix cache for this tenant) to stop pollution spreading and then assess rewarm.

Thomas (Infra): I can do per-tenant cache toggle. Preparing to run the runbook. Confirming: disable prefix cache for bigenterprise-tenant-7 only, not global.

Aj Patel: +1. Also recommend temporarily route tenant to no-cache path to keep latency stable. Will update routing policy to bypass prefix cache.

ops-bot: ACTION LOG: user Thomas (Infra) executed: 
```
/rwctl cache toggle --tenant bigenterprise-tenant-7 --cache-prefix off --scope tenant
```
Result: command accepted, propagation started.

Thomas (Infra): disabled prefix cache for tenant. Propagating change to edge nodes (expected 30s).

ops-bot: CONFIG EVENT: routing rule updated: 
```
route: tenant/bigenterprise-tenant-7 -> no-prefix-cache-tier
priority: high
```
Propagation: started.

maria (SRE): after disable: observed immediate increase in hit_rate for remaining shared cache entries (no further pollution). Latency for tenant stabilized p95 down ~40ms from peak, error-rate falling. Good immediate mitigation.

Customer Success - Elena: Told customer we disabled the tenant prefix cache to mitigate. They asked if this will affect cost/perf long-term — said we'll follow up. They are relieved for now.

oncall-sre: root cause hypothesis: automated integration test run from customer's staging started sending thousands of pseudo-random prefix keys (likely a misconfigured client-side templating), causing KV store eviction and extreme churn. Need to confirm with request traces.

eng-ml - Joon: I pulled a sample of recent requests for tenant. Many requests include near-unique prefixes generated from a session id in prompt: e.g., prefix: "user-msg-<random-uuid>-ctx". That will always pollute. Suggest normalizing prefix extraction to strip session ids for caching heuristics or add client-side guidance.

Aj Patel: For immediate follow-up: 1) Keep tenant cache disabled; 2) Purge any polluted prefix shards for tenant; 3) Throttle or rate-limit high-cardinality prefix creation if it recurs; 4) Work with CS to notify customer and suggest quick client-side fix.

Thomas (Infra): running purge on tenant prefix namespaces now. Command: 
```
/rwctl kv purge --tenant bigenterprise-tenant-7 --namespace prefix_cache --filter "created_at > now()-1h"
```
ops-bot: Purge job started on 20 nodes, estimated 90s.

ops-bot: Purge job completed. Evicted ~3.2M keys associated with tenant prefix namespace. Memory reclaimed across nodes.

maria (SRE): Observed cache footprint drop and steadying of eviction rate. Hit-rate slowly improving as we rebuild healthy entries from live traffic.

Customer Success - Elena: Customer confirmed errors subsided; they're running a reduced load test to validate. They asked for a timeline to re-enable cache.

eng-ml - Joon: Recommend waiting for two 15-min windows of stable low-cardinality traffic before re-enabling. Also will prepare a normalization patch to strip session-like tokens from prefix extraction (PR ready, needs staging validation).

Aj Patel: I'm drafting an internal post-incident note and assigning action items:
- Joon: PR for prefix normalization and heuristics (owner).
- Thomas: Safe re-enable runbook and post-purge validation (owner).
- Maria: Add tenant-specific alerting thresholds and auto-disable playbook for future.
- CS (Elena): Coordinate communications and recommend client changes.

oncall-sre: Handoff note: I'm handing this to @Aj Patel for monitoring and remediation while I go for a quick break. Last checked 1799801400. Aj, take over; escalate to infra if we see eviction > threshold.

Aj Patel: Taking over. Will keep monitoring dashboards and follow up with scheduled re-enable window after PR lands and traffic normalizes.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity downgraded from Sev2 -> Sev3 at 1799801450. Customer impact reduced to transient latency spikes; errors resolved.

maria (SRE): One more technical note: we should add a per-tenant cache size cap and reactive heuristics (if unique prefix churn > X / min => auto-disable for tenant). I'll include in the follow-up runbook.

Customer Success - Elena: I'll send an official post-mitigation note to BigEnterprise with suggested client-side fix and offer a follow-up call.

eng-ml - Joon: Logging action: I'll attach sample request traces and a suggested normalization regex to the incident ticket. Example: strip tokens matching /-[0-9a-f]{8,}/ from prefixes.

oncall-sre: Closing operational loop here: mitigation in place, purge done, CS notified. Assigning RCA to eng-ml and infra. Will reopen if regression.

Aj Patel: Logged follow-up tasks in internal tracker. Re-enable plan tentative for 1799802200 if traffic looks stable and PR merges.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: incident-id=inc-2026-0794, impacted-tenant=bigenterprise-tenant-7, mitigations=tenant-prefix-cache-disabled,prefix-purge,route-bypass, status=mitigated.

ops-bot: REMINDER: Please run post-mortem template: /incident postmortem create inc-2026-0794 and include timeline, root cause hypothesis, customer comms, code PR links, and prevention items.

oncall-sre: ack. I'll draft the timeline and initial notes. Thanks team.

(End of thread)
